title: A Comprehensive Evaluation of Cognitive Biases in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs using a framework of paired control and treatment templates in managerial decision-making scenarios. The framework measures shifts in multiple-choice decisions (on Likert or percentage scales) to detect 30 specific cognitive heuristics, such as the framing effect, anchoring, loss aversion, confirmation bias, and the halo effect.

Prompting the LLM to choose characteristics for a group of people (covering different genders, ethnicities, sexual orientations, religious beliefs, and job types) to determine if the model switches from choosing atypical traits to stereotypical traits when the specific group identity is explicitly revealed.

Using a variation of the dictator game where the LLM is prompted to assign a reward to one of two subjects, testing whether the model preferentially selects the subject that shares a designated group attribution with the model.
